text:
liam_release: kicking off the weekend stair-step cutover for v2.3.1 in US -> EU -> APAC. primary window 23:00-03:00 PT, canary slices for each region, follow the playbook.
sara_eng: ack. I ran a final smoke of the canary prompts vs baseline, no regressions locally. link: https://redwood.internal/release-notes/v2.3.1
matt_ops: capacity checks look good: US warmpool=120 GPU, EU=60, APAC=40. Thermal headroom reserved: 15% across zones.
katie_sre: callouts: EU change window must respect batch processing cutoff at 01:00 UTC. avoid rolling during heavy nightly batch jobs.
liam_release: noted. we'll stagger start times: US canary 23:15 PT, EU canary 01:30 PT (01:30 UTC?), APAC main at 02:30 PT (night local). devon_oncall pls confirm oncall coverage for APAC slice.
devon_oncall: I can be on the APAC window, matt you ok for EU ramp?
matt_ops: yep, I'll monitor EU and global routing. I'll keep the extra warm nodes until APAC finishes.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: initiating rollout v2.3.1 -> model-serving-cluster/us-canary
deploy-bot: canary slice: 3 replicas, 1 minute warmup, smoke tests running
sara_eng: running smoke set A now, sending prompts in parallel. small perf diffs expected.
katie_sre: reminder: rollback trigger = sustained 5xx > 1% for 5m OR p95 latency > 500ms for 5m OR eval regression > 2% on smoke set. document: /handbook/releases/rollbacks
deploy-bot: canary smoke: 0 errors, p95=120ms, qps baseline +/-2%
liam_release: canary looks green for US. schedule US -> ramp to 25% over 10m, then 50% after 15m if no alerts.
matt_ops: ramping US to 25% now. routing slice id = rs-us-23.
deploy-bot: routing update applied: rs-us-23 -> v2.3.1 (25%)
sara_eng: quick note: prefix cache hit rate dropped 3% during canary ramp, but within expected variance.
katie_sre: keep an eye on cache miss amplification, that can push latency under load.
liam_release: proceed to 50% in 10m if steady.
(10m passes)
matt_ops: US at 50%, token throughput stable, no CPU/GPU throttling.
deploy-bot: US canary promoted to 100% for US cluster.
liam_release: pin US traffic to v2.3.1 and start EU canary at 01:30 PT. note: EU uses private subnet; ensure cert refresh completed.
deploy-bot: initiating rollout -> model-serving-cluster/eu-canary
katie_sre: EU canary started. setting stricter latency SLO to 450ms p95 for canary phase due to multi-tenant ingress.
sara_eng: EU smoke set B running. sending function-call tests as well.
matt_ops: EU capacity: added 8 extra warm pods to avoid cold starts.
deploy-bot: eu-canary smoke: 2 failures (transient), investigating logs:
```
ERROR: kvcache-miss: shard 12 timeout 200ms
WARN: retries=1
```
sara_eng: those kvcache-miss spikes align with a concurrent nightly job starting at 01:10 UTC, might be noisy.
katie_sre: if failures go >0.5% sustained for 3m we pause. current 0.08% over 5m. continue but keep watchers.
liam_release: agree continue. matt, defer EU to 50% only if p95 < 450ms for 5m.
matt_ops: EU at 25% now.
(20m later)
matt_ops: EU p95 sitting ~420ms, errors holding at 0.12%. moving to 50%.
deploy-bot: eu-canary -> 50%
liam_release: good. after EU stabilizes we'll start APAC stair-step. APAC ramp will be more conservative (15% -> 40% -> 100%) due to lower reserve.
devon_oncall: APAC monitoring hooks set, I'll escalate on any regional routing anomalies.
deploy-bot: starting apac preflight: validate certs, nodepool readiness check...
deploy-bot: apac preflight OK, starting apac-canary at 15%
sara_eng: APAC smoke running. note: latency to APAC region higher because of cross-region KV lookups during initial phased rollout. expected to drop as local caches warm.
katie_sre: watch token cost spike during APAC warm; enable short-term token cap alerts.
matt_ops: APAC 15% steady. increasing to 40% in 12m.
(12m)
matt_ops: APAC 40% now. observed p95=560ms during brief spike, but it's transient and back down to 310ms. spike coincided with node eviction in apac-us-east-2 zone.
katie_sre: that eviction was part of unrelated maintenance? If so we should pause until nodes recovered.
matt_ops: yes caused by infra autoscaler trim, I re-enabled reserved nodes. metrics trending stable.
deploy-bot: apac-canary -> 40%
liam_release: given the eviction spike, we'll hold at 40% for 30m then decide. rollback criteria still active.
(15m)
katie_sre: after 15m at 40% no regression. I authorize final ramp to 100% for APAC in 10m.
liam_release: final ramping APAC to 100% now. make sure traffic pin for fallback region is configured (fallback->us for APAC if capacity issues).
deploy-bot: apac done: v2.3.1 live (100%)
sara_eng: running post-deploy evaluation set C, sampling 5000 responses for QA. sending report in 30m.
liam_release: excellent. notes: release notes posted, customers mailing list scheduled for 06:00 PT. tagging release docs and rollback checklist. thanks team. :tada:
matt_ops: unlocking warmpool reservations gradually. leaving 10% cushion for the next 24h.
katie_sre: watch error budget for 2h after full rollout, otherwise we'll trigger automated slowdown.
devon_oncall: I'll stay on until 06:00 PT then handoff to dayops.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: rollout complete. v2.3.1 applied across US/EU/APAC.
liam_release: closing thread. postmortem iff any incidents within 24h. good job everyone. :rocket:
